notes: §1985:VI.5.3.3 SR3: "The PICTURE clause must be specified for every elementary item except an index data item and the subject of the RENAMES clause, in which case use of this clause is prohibited." The requirement: CheckPictureRequiredPass.Run reports COBOL0881 for every entry IsPictureLessLeaf finds (no PICTURE, no subordinate, not level 66 or 88) once usage inheritance has given an index data item its profile. The 1985 edition arm is the later exception: 2002 lets a VALUE literal imply the PICTURE, and SynthesizeImpliedPicture asks the registry row value-implied-picture-2002 before it supplies one, so 85 draws COBOL0900. The prohibition: BindEntry and UsageInheritanceElementary refuse a PICTURE beside a written or inherited USAGE INDEX (Sr8PicturelessVerdict, COBOL0881), and the level 66 entry is the grammar alternative renamesClause of dataDescriptionBody, which takes no other clause. Probed at --std 85: refused without a PICTURE are a level 77, 01 (File, Working-Storage and Linkage Sections), subordinate and FILLER entry with no clause, with USAGE DISPLAY, COMP, BINARY or PACKED-DECIMAL, with OCCURS, SIGN, JUSTIFIED or BLANK WHEN ZERO, under a USAGE COMP group, and with VALUE "A", VALUE SPACES, VALUE ZERO or VALUE 42; accepted without one are USAGE INDEX on a level 77, on an elementary item under a USAGE INDEX group and on a table element, and 66 R RENAMES A THRU B; refused with one are PIC 9 USAGE INDEX and RENAMES written with PIC in either order. The usages a later edition makes picture-less are each refused at 85 by their own introduction gate; COMP-1 and COMP-2, the documented extension (COBOL2894 under --flag-extensions), are no 1985 item. The witness is 77 WS-B USAGE DISPLAY, refused with COBOL0881.

VALUE". 2023 accepts an elementary item without PICTURE when a nonzero-length literal VALUE is given (PICTURE implied); 1985 refuses such programs.
